text:
Ari: Quick async check for this quarter's milestone: FastBoot feature set. Short status please — what shipped, what slipped, owners, any CR pings or blockers. TL;DR I’ll collect and update the milestone doc.

Sam: Infra update — backend canary is running at 10% since Tue. p95 latency up ~8ms, investigating root cause, no customer impact yet. PRs: infra/fastboot-deploy (review requested from @Claire).

Priya: Product: we shipped rollout controls and the new rollout dashboard. UI integration for the admin flow slipped because feature flags didn't propagate to the SPA. Moving the non-essential visual tweaks out of this milestone.

Luis: Frontend: blocked — auth header schema changed in backend, causing 401s. Repro locally, working on a patch. Aim to land by EOD Fri. PR will include a smoke test. CR needed from @Priya.

Claire: I’ll pick up infra PR review now — will add a retry in the test harness for the flaky e2e. Expect to finish in ~2h.

Ari: Action items (short):
```
1) @Sam: triage p95 regression + add log fields (create infra ticket)
2) @Luis: land frontend patch + run staging smoke
3) @Priya: deprioritize non-critical UI bits and update milestone doc
4) @Claire: finish review and add test-harness retry
```

Sam: INF-1291 created: https://redwood.internal/INF-1291 — added initial log fields and a perf trace hook. ETA tracing hook in prod by tomorrow AM.

Luis: PR opened: https://git.redwood/fastboot/frontend/pull/198 — fix + unit tests included. Triggering staging job now.

Priya: Acknowledged. I updated the milestone doc to show "backend: shipped (canary)" and "ui: slipped"; moving owner for dashboard polish to @Maria (ops).

Claire: Infra PR merged (infra/fastboot-deploy). Adding hotfix for test harness now.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started — fastboot v1.23.4 -> canary (10%), job 7821.

Ari: Thanks all. Current milestone state: backend partially shipped (canary live), UI integration slipped. We’ll re-run a short async sync mid-week if regressions persist. If you can’t meet ETAs above, reply with ETA here. :thumbsup:
